page_title: ARS 2-0 BHA | Arsenal v Brighton 17/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' We are about to witness a substitution. Jakub Kiwior (Arsenal) is replacing Oleksandr Zinchenko.

90+3' Emile Smith Rowe (Arsenal) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Bart Verbruggen makes a great save.
90+1' A corner kick by Brighton is thwarted by the well prepared David Raya (Arsenal).
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Pascal Gross (Brighton) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
89' Mikel Arteta has decided to substitute Bukayo Saka and he is replaced by Reiss Nelson (Arsenal).
89' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Emile Smith Rowe (Arsenal) is coming onto the pitch as Kai Havertz cannot continue after picking up an injury.

87' 2 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Eddie Nketiah, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Kai Havertz (Arsenal), who beats Bart Verbruggen with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 2:0.
87' Pascal Gross (Brighton) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal will have a goal kick.

84' Declan Rice (Arsenal) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to place a shot inside the right post, but Bart Verbruggen makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory.

83' What a huge chance for Pascal Gross (Brighton). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Arsenal.
82' Substitution. Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) in, Gabriel Martinelli out.
81' Here is a change. Gabriel Jesus is going off and Mikel Arteta gives the last tactical orders to Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal).
80' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 10:0.
79' The referee signals a substitution. Danny Welbeck (Brighton) is brought on as a substitute for Simon Adingra.
76' Billy Gilmour (Brighton) gets booked for the first time in this match.
75' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
75' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender. The ball goes out of play. Arsenal are awarded a corner kick.

74' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the top left corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from Bart Verbruggen, who tips the ball over the bar. The linesman makes the right call and Arsenal will have a corner.
73' Joao Pedro (Brighton) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
72' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) whips in a vicious corner direct on goal, but the keeper makes a confident catch on the line.
71' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
69' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

69' Ben White (Arsenal) plants a good close-range header towards goal from the corner kick, but it comes to nothing as a defender comfortably blocks the effort. Good work from Arsenal as they win a corner.
68' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
68' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
67' Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
66' Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) picks up an injury.
65' Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the roof of the net. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and David Raya makes a comfortable save.
64' Brighton are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
62' A player from Brighton commits a rough challenge. Tim Robinson blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
60' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from James Milner as he is replaced by Igor (Brighton).
60' Roberto De Zerbi prepares a substitution. Adam Lallana is replaced by Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton).
60' Today's match ends for Evan Ferguson who will be replaced by Joao Pedro (Brighton).
59' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
57' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) commits a rough challenge and Tim Robinson blows his whistle for an infringement.
55' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) prepares to take a corner kick.
55' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
54' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
53' 1 - 0 Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) finds some space inside the box and powers his header past the goalkeeper, giving him no chance.
53' Arsenal earn a corner.

52' Martin Odegaard received a sweet pass from Bukayo Saka (Arsenal), but the advance is stopped. Arsenal have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
50' Brighton seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
48' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) commits a rough challenge and Tim Robinson blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Martin Odegaard picks out Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) unmarked inside the box, but he blazes the ball well over the bar.
45+3' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Arsenal comes to nothing.
45+2' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. The ball is out of play. Arsenal will have a chance to score from a corner.
45+1' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
45+1' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Bart Verbruggen intercepts the ball.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
43' Referee Tim Robinson halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Mikel Arteta, then shows him a yellow.
43' Tim Robinson shows a yellow card to Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) for his blatant foul.
40' Declan Rice (Arsenal) gets his head on the corner, but he can't find the target as his header flies high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
40' The referee blows his whistle, Arsenal are awarded a corner kick.
39' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.

39' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Bart Verbruggen pulls off an easy save.
38' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ben White (Arsenal) was quite harsh and Tim Robinson didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
37' Simon Adingra (Brighton) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
37' The total number of attempts is 8:0. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 3:0.
35' The ball is cleared after Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
33' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) inside the box following a slide rule pass.

32' Bukayo Saka plays a pass to Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal), but he fails to get a decent shot away from inside the box and the ball goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
31' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
30' Pascal Gross (Brighton) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
29' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) makes a rough challenge and Tim Robinson blows his whistle for a foul.
27' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) is coming onto the pitch as Joel Veltman cannot continue after picking up an injury.
25' An attempted cross from Lewis Dunk (Brighton) is cleared.
23' Joel Veltman (Brighton) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.

23' Gabriel (Arsenal) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Bart Verbruggen, who pulls off a comfortable save!
22' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) is about to take a corner kick.
21' The game is interrupted now, Joel Veltman (Brighton) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
20' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. Arsenal will take a corner kick.

19' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Bart Verbruggen pulls off an easy save.
17' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
16' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
16' Tim Robinson has a clear sight and sees a foul from James Milner (Brighton).
15' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
14' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
13' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) controls a reverse pass deep inside the box and smacks the ball low towards the middle of the goal, but the Bart Verbruggen anticipates well and smothers the ball.
10' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
9' Brighton enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
7' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Tim Robinson saw the whole situation.
6' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
4' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) is able to continue to play.
3' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
2' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) releases Gabriel Jesus with a precise pass and he attempts to finish, but is immediately surrounded by the defenders and loses the ball.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Brighton will have the kick-off.
Tim Robinson will supervise the game today.
